actual_scope: Source-bound portability of the selected PR1094 invoice subgraph: global/audit/PREFIX-AND-INVOICE.json and its two input_sha256/fresh_invoice consumers ADMISSION-CONTROLS.json and ASSEMBLY.json. Authenticate both literal edges before replacing them with the complete typed invoice identity; compare every other field without exemptions.
scope_change_reason: PR2040 explicitly leaves the observed Linux invoice-key-order/raw-reference mismatch unresolved. This changes neither its typed/path audit nor the prior seven-local-artifact identity audit; it supplies the missing reference-binding comparison for this three-node generated subgraph.
bottleneck_link: Portable replay must accept a generated JSON reformat only with freshly valid raw receipt references, without mistaking synchronized semantic tampering for an environment difference. No supplier, paid profile or kappa change.
stop_rule: One three-node selected1094 subgraph only. Stop after a complete field-preservation argument, source-bound transformation experiment, semantic rejection census and focused replay. Do not rebuild the cold supplier or investigate CI.
evidence: RESULT.json:105strictfiles,3041tree nodes,two direct raw references; seven formatting positives;6076field mutations including5296synchronized invoice mutations;57edge/parser/type negatives;6133total rejections. README proves the exact authenticate-before-rebind boundary. Verification engineering only, not mathematical admission.
author: Adam Gall (@adamgall), with OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance in audit design, implementation, experiments, tests and writing. No independent human review claimed.
method: Exact standard-library typed JSON comparison, independent full-tree oracle, complete direct-consumer census over all 105 reviewed strict output files, formatting permutations and synchronized semantic mutations.

domain.allowed_variation: Object order, insignificant JSON whitespace and equivalent JSON string escapes only. No excluded timing, path, digest, list order, numerical or proof field.
domain.negative_controls: Stale and cross-wired edges; one edge repaired but the other stale; both sides malformed; receipt semantic fields; synchronized invoice mutations with both edges updated; duplicate keys and nonfinite or unexpected decimal numbers.

optimistic_full_budget: Verification engineering, not a construction proposal: recursive word, all physical/interface costs and selected kappa unchanged. Acceptance requires every field retained, both raw links authenticated on each side, a legitimate portable formatting variant accepted, and every declared semantic fault rejected. No speedup claim.
success_evidence: A complete source-bound graph equivalence checker and portable positive witness with exhaustive declared mutation coverage, not whole-file hash substitution alone.
falsification_test: Any semantic edit accepted after consistently rebinding both raw invoice references falsifies the required comparator property.
